validation.scope: all complete sequence blocks; do not substitute a small subset
validation.aggregation: sum token negative log likelihood divided by valid shifted token count

convergence_claim: Validation plateau on this fixed WikiText continual-pretraining task only; never original pretraining convergence
test_policy: Evaluate held-out test once after restoring best validation parameters; never tune on test

resource_policy.reason: Available disk cannot hold approximately 92 GiB full optimizer checkpoint
resource_policy.best_parameters: One reusable CPU snapshot per rank; no repeated 16 GiB model exports during validation
